column1: # Character pools built by ArcSelect Init FUN_0079df00 (vectors 0x9b8de0+12*player) and VS Select Init FUN_0079acc0 (same vectors). Order = list index order.
# unlock flag = byte DAT_0087b72c + id (0x87b72f..0x87b73d). Icon carousel draws index+k at x = W/2 - k*90s (FUN_0079fb30), so higher index = further LEFT on screen.
# ArcSelect: Sumika (17) only if DAT_0087faa8==0 (arcade). VS: Sumika if unlocked, then id 1 (Random "???") always last (0x79b431).

# default cursors when entering from the main menu (DAT_00885874==4): ArcSelect DAT_009b6ac8 = index of 10 (Suguri); VS P1 DAT_009b6ac8 = index of 10 (Suguri), P2 DAT_009b6acc = index of 3 (Sora) (0x79be3d/0x79be66); otherwise cursors are kept.
